filePanel.title: Workbook files
filePanel.instructions: Select the Master Document List and the Document Submittal Log for each load.
filePanel.validation: Both files are required. The dashboard checks each workbook before it shows data.

pages.Overview: Submission totals, plan coverage, status, approval, and delay measures.
pages.Breakdown: Three independent panels: Submissions, Approval Status and Breakdown Summary. Each panel owns its Month, Break-down-by and, for charts, Bar/Pie view. Others means a Document Submittal Log row whose Document No. is not registered in the MDL workbook.
pages.Submittals: All submission rows and calculated turnaround and delay values.
pages.Validation: Two independent panels: Validation Rules shows the loaded and fired rule counts with one row per fired code; Validation Issues shows the issue counts with severity totals and an error-code filter that narrows only the Issues panel.
pages.Forward and Overdue: Look-ahead (next 1–4 weeks), Overdue (past due), and Coverage (not-yet-submitted MDL rows).
pages.Analytical: Open overdue records, review aging, and the forward queue.
pages.Help: Load both workbooks, use global filters, and select a page.
